title: EU AI Act Article 13 — Transparency and provision of information to users
description: The transparency obligation within the EU AI Act for high-risk AI systems. Paraphrase pending verification against the primary EUR-Lex text — hence 'Community' confidence.
control_text: High-risk AI systems must be designed and developed with sufficient transparency to enable deployers to interpret a system's output and use it appropriately, accompanied by instructions for use that let deployers and, in turn, affected users understand how the system's information should be relied upon.

citations.title: Regulation (EU) 2024/1689 laying down harmonised rules on artificial intelligence (Artificial Intelligence Act)
citations.publisher: EUR-Lex / Official Journal of the European Union

relationships.reason: Satisfying this control requires documented evidence that users can rely on system output appropriately.
